name: template-context-reserved
body: The `deck`, `slide` and `item` context keys must be reserved top-level template-context names available in every slide layout and every section instance at every composition depth (`item` is nil/absent at slide level); a template declaring a field or section named `deck`, `slide` or `item` is a templates error at load time, and exposing this context must add no layout helper (the v1 helper set stays exactly `media`).
